detail.longDescription: Question for devs: how much of your disk is stuff you could regenerate with one command? node_modules, Rust target/ folders, .gradle, Xcode DerivedData, pip and npm caches, old Docker images… it all adds up quietly across old projects. I freed 91 GB the first time I actually measured it 😬 Which folder is your worst offender? And do you clean it by hand, with a script, or never? # webdev # programming # rust # linux
